verdict.rationale: Ramp's programmatic surface is broad. It has a 174-path OpenAPI Developer API covering transactions, bills, virtual cards and vault, custom records, and spend controls. It also ships an agent-mode CLI spanning 12 resources (bills, cards, funds, reimbursements, travel, users, and more) and an OAuth-gated MCP server with dozens of read/write scopes. However, Ramp never claims UI parity. Its own docs admit gaps, such as bill approvals not being available via MCP. Some setup steps are UI-only: creating developer apps under Company → Developer and configuring MCP access in the dashboard. Missing for 10: a documented commitment to API/UI parity, API coverage of setup and admin configuration (app creation, MCP access restrictions), and independent verification that UI-only features are absent.
